# Markbel - Full System Specification & Architecture Manual

## 1. System Overview
Markbel is an open-source, local-first, offline-capable bookmark management and rich media archiving platform. It provides sub-millisecond local database interactions using Dexie.js (IndexedDB) and edge-based synchronization over Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare D1 SQLite.

---

## 2. Database Schemas

### 2.1 Client Schema (Dexie.js IndexedDB)
```typescript
interface Bookmark {
  id: string;              // Primary key (UUID v4 or nanoid)
  userId: string;          // Account ID or 'guest'
  url: string;             // Target URL
  title: string;           // Bookmark title
  description?: string;    // Extracted description or user note
  image?: string;          // Extracted thumbnail or poster URL
  group?: string;          // Group category ID or name
  isRead: boolean;         // Read/Unread flag
  isPinned: boolean;       // Pinned priority flag
  isArchived: boolean;     // Archive status flag
  archiveGroup?: string;   // Optional archive bucket
  remindAt?: string;       // ISO 8601 reminder timestamp
  readAt?: string;         // ISO 8601 read timestamp
  createdAt: string;       // ISO 8601 creation timestamp
  updatedAt: string;       // ISO 8601 mutation timestamp (used in LWW)
  deletedAt?: string;      // Soft delete timestamp
}

interface Group {
  id: string;              // Primary key
  userId: string;          // Account ID or 'guest'
  name: string;            // Group display name
  color: string;           // Group accent color hex or token
  createdAt: string;       // ISO 8601 creation timestamp
  updatedAt: string;       // ISO 8601 mutation timestamp
  deletedAt?: string;      // Soft delete timestamp
}

interface SyncQueueItem {
  id: string;              // Local outbox mutation ID
  entity: 'bookmark' | 'group';
  action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete';
  entityId: string;
  data: Partial<Bookmark | Group>;
  timestamp: string;       // ISO 8601 timestamp
}
```

### 2.2 Server Schema (Cloudflare D1 SQLite)
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookmarks (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  url TEXT NOT NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  image TEXT,
  "group" TEXT,
  is_read INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_pinned INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  is_archived INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  archive_group TEXT,
  remind_at TEXT,
  read_at TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  deleted_at TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS groups (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  color TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  deleted_at TEXT,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_changes (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity TEXT NOT NULL,
  action TEXT NOT NULL,
  entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  data TEXT NOT NULL,
  sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sync_changes_user_seq ON sync_changes(user_id, sequence);
```

---

## 3. Synchronization Protocol

### 3.1 Push Protocol
- **Endpoint**: `POST /api/sync/push`
- **Headers**: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": "outbox_101",
      "entity": "bookmark",
      "action": "create",
      "entityId": "bmk_abc123",
      "data": {
        "url": "https://example.com",
        "title": "Example Title",
        "updatedAt": "2026-08-31T12:00:00.000Z"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
- **Response Body**:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "synced": ["outbox_101"],
  "latestSequence": 42
}
```

### 3.2 Pull Protocol
- **Endpoint**: `GET /api/sync/pull?since={sequence}`
- **Headers**: `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`
- **Response Body**:
```json
{
  "changes": [
    {
      "id": "evt_501",
      "entity": "bookmark",
      "action": "update",
      "entityId": "bmk_abc123",
      "data": {
        "title": "Updated Title",
        "updatedAt": "2026-08-31T12:05:00.000Z"
      },
      "sequence": 43
    }
  ],
  "latestSequence": 43
}
```

### 3.3 Conflict Resolution (Last-Write-Wins)
When a pull payload arrives:
1. The client looks up the local entity by `entityId`.
2. If the local entity exists and `local.updatedAt > remote.updatedAt`, the remote change is rejected and the local state is preserved.
3. If `local.updatedAt <= remote.updatedAt` or the local record is absent, the remote state overwrites local IndexedDB.
4. The client cursor (`lastSequence`) is updated to the maximum sequence received.

---

## 4. Metadata Extraction Engine

The edge metadata endpoint (`GET /api/metadata?url={url}`) extracts rich media:
1. **YouTube**: Matches `youtube.com/watch?v=`, `youtu.be/`, and `youtube.com/shorts/`.
   - Requests `https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url={url}&format=json`.
   - Generates thumbnail fallback: `https://img.youtube.com/vi/{id}/hqdefault.jpg`.
2. **TikTok**: Queries `https://www.tiktok.com/oembed?url={url}` for title, author name, and thumbnail URL.
3. **Twitter / X**: Queries `https://publish.twitter.com/oembed?url={url}` for tweet HTML content and author name.
4. **OpenGraph & Standard Web**: Fetches the target page with HTML parsing for `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `twitter:image`, and standard `<title>` / `<meta name="description">` tags.

---

## 5. Security & Authentication
- **Password Hashing**: PBKDF2 with SHA-256 and unique user salts.
- **Session Tokens**: Stateless JSON Web Tokens (JWT) signed using WebCrypto HMAC-SHA256.
- **Offline Survival**: JWT is cached in `localStorage`; local IndexedDB reads/writes proceed without requiring an active network connection.
- **Guest Migration**: Data created anonymously under `userId: 'guest'` is re-assigned to the user's account ID and scheduled for cloud delta push upon first login.
